status: Descriptive history only; no forecast, causal or calibration claim
inclusion: Metadata eligible=true, start date>=2016-01-01, exactly11roster entries, scheduled50overs, ordinary innings order1or2. Eligibility is retrospective and can apply to one innings of a match without the other.
exclusions: Source eligible flag excludes no-results,D/L,DLS,VJD,unsupported events,non11rosters,superovers,miscounted/overbudget and other documented reasons; inspect original metadata per-innings exclusions.

definitions.grain: One row per scope, batting context and number of actual batting participants2..11. Summary columns repeat across ten depth rows; do not sum repeated sample sizes.
definitions.batting_participation: Count players with runs is not None. Runs0/balls0 participants count; DNB has runs=None and balls_faced=None. Never use max(position) or number of players who faced a ball.
definitions.count_team_innings: Number of team innings with precisely n_batters participants.
definitions.frequency: count_team_innings/sample_team_innings within a scope and batting context; sums1 over n_batters2..11.
definitions.mean_team_balls_faced: Total non-wide deliveries/sample_team_innings; includes no-balls and excludes wides.
definitions.mean_balls_per_batting_appearance: Total non-wide deliveries/total_batting_appearances, including zero-ball appearances.
definitions.p50_per_batting_appearance: Count observed batting appearances scoring>=50 divided by actual batting appearances.
definitions.p100_per_batting_appearance: Count observed batting appearances scoring>=100 divided by actual batting appearances.
definitions.p50_per_roster_entry: Count observed50+ appearances/(11*sample_team_innings); includes DNB in denominator.
definitions.p100_per_roster_entry: Count observed100+ appearances/(11*sample_team_innings); includes DNB in denominator.
definitions.batting_context: Combined includes first and second ordinary innings. Batting first=innings_order1; Chasing=innings_order2.
definitions.location: NZ indicator from metadata's audited exact-source venue list. Ground labels are source names, not merged physical venues; e.g.Westpac Stadium and Sky Stadium remain separate.

caveats: Archive population is not every ODI ever played; coverage and retrospective exclusions apply.
Do not compare these descriptive all-team rates with India/NZ evaluation rates as identical populations.
Both team innings from one match are dependent; counts do not establish independent sample size.
Exact-ground sample sizes can be small. Descriptive differences do not establish venue causation.
Historical realised batting order/participation are labels, not known pre-match features.
